liquid.question: Answer YES if the image is a flat poster, advertisement, page, chart, drawing or painting presented as the content; a screenshot with app/browser/game controls; or an obvious computer-generated render. A beautifully designed graphic is still excluded. Answer NO for an actual photographed scene, packaging, signage, physical display or sculpture with context and for uncertain cases. This is a domain decision, not a technical or aesthetic rating.

jev.question: Is the image itself clearly a screenshot or user interface, a flat poster, page, diagram, illustration, painting reproduction, or an obvious computer render? Answer YES for excluded media. Answer NO for a photograph of a physical scene or object with meaningful context, even with text, signs, packaging, screens, artwork or sculpture; answer NO if uncertain.
